title: Every Graphyard project on one host shares two ordinary heavy-job slots and a gate/deploy reservation
description: Two fixture installs on one host launch eight heavy jobs from their own processes — sessions’ whole suites with nested work, merge and batch-gate trials, a preview build and deploy builds — and never more than two ordinary jobs plus one reserved gate/deploy job run at once; every queued job runs, a waiting job names the shared limit and the jobs and projects holding it, nested work runs on its parent's slot, a lowered limit leaves running jobs alone and admits none until below it, and finished, failed, cancelled and dead holders all give their slot back.

steps.name: two installs share the host budget and gate/deploy reservation
